jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - NodeJS / NestJS

jobs.description:

- 3+ years of professional NodeJS / NestJS backend experience
- Strong command of TypeScript and RESTful API design principles
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, and message queues
- Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS / GCP)
- Good understanding of security best practices (OWASP Top 10)

Nice to have:

- Knowledge of GraphQL and API gateway patterns
